company.name: Response
company.description:
Response is a Y Combinator-backed SaaS platform designed to help 3PLs, distributors, and retailers simplify and optimize indirect spend—everyday purchases like packaging, maintenance supplies, and office essentials. By providing real-time SKU-level visibility, automated purchase controls, and actionable insights, Response enables companies to reduce costs, eliminate rogue spend, and streamline procurement workflows.

Customers, including Warehouse Specialists Inc. (WSI) and Aterian (NASDAQ: ATER), have achieved up to 13.2% cost savings through vendor consolidation and up to 91.6% reduction in time spent ordering.

Our vision is to build the world’s first digital procurement officer for indirect spend, leveraging AI to take the busywork of ordering and the guesswork of vendor negotiations off our customers’ plates.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes and manages indirect spend by consolidating vendor orders, enforcing spend controls, and providing real-time visibility into procurement activities.
productsAndServices.name: Response Procurement Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool within the platform that manages purchase orders end-to-end, allowing users to create, track, and control POs across multiple vendors and locations.
productsAndServices.name: Purchase Order Management

productsAndServices.description: Features that allow organizations to set spend limits, automate approval processes, and enforce compliance with purchasing policies to prevent unauthorized spending.
productsAndServices.name: Spend Control and Approval Workflows

productsAndServices.description: Customizable online storefronts that restrict product visibility and purchasing options based on department or location to ensure compliance with approved catalogs.
productsAndServices.name: Personalized Storefronts

productsAndServices.description: Tools that provide detailed spending data and insights at the SKU level to help organizations monitor procurement activities and identify savings opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Analytics and Reporting

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,160,000, or 96.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,251,740 to $20,364,558, a 6.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
